sections.heading: Over 30 years on the road, kindness first
sections.intro:
For more than 30 years Hai Van has put passengers' safety and kindness first — from the moment you walk into the lounge until you step off the bus. On the Ho Chi Minh City – Vung Tau route, over 120 limousine departures a day are ready for you, with flexible pickup and booking right on your phone.
Kindness from the heart – care in every action

sections.heading: Bus schedules & fares: Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau
A more considerate way to Vung Tau
sections.intro:
Over 30 years carrying passengers, Hai Van prioritizes your comfort and safety. Every trip is driven by a seasoned driver who knows the route, in a vehicle kept to standard.
Hai Van is also one of the few operators allowed to pick up and drop off right at terminals T1, T2 and T3 of Tan Son Nhat Airport, so your airport–Vung Tau leg stays seamless, easy and unhurried.

items.title: Terminals open almost all day
items.text: Ho Chi Minh City departures run 5am–midnight and Vung Tau 2am–9:45pm. A bus every 15–30 minutes, so there is no single timetable to plan around.

items.title: Flexible pickup and drop-off
items.text: Board at an office, a stop on the route or by door-to-door shuttle from most districts. Share your address when booking so Hai Van confirms the meeting point; shuttle coverage varies by departure.

items.title: Tan Son Nhat airport service
items.text: The Hai Van desk sits at the airport pickup column inside Tan Son Nhat: luggage help, ticketing and a place to wait. The bus collects you at the desk, not from an outdoor car park. If your flight is late, call to move to a later departure.

items.title: 3 vehicle classes, 100% limousine
items.text: More than 40 Royal, Luxury and Economy buses. Air conditioning, wifi, USB charging, water and cool towels on board; massage seats on the higher classes. Compare interiors below the timetable.

items.title: No overcrowding, no extra seats
items.text: Every passenger gets a numbered seat from the map. Hai Van sells no extra seats, allows no floor spaces and takes on no extra passengers along the way; buses keep to the registered route and slots. Fares include VAT.

items.title: E-tickets, flexible changes
items.text: Pick your own seat on the map and the e-ticket lands straight on your phone. To change or cancel, just call 1900 6763 at least an hour before departure.

sections.heading: Hai Van lounges and airport ticket desks
sections.intro: Three lounges in Ho Chi Minh City and one in Vung Tau, open 7:00am – 9:00pm daily with staff on hand, air-conditioning, drinks and luggage storage. If you land at Tan Son Nhat, Hai Van has a desk at all three terminals — T1, T2 and T3. Buses keep running outside lounge hours as shown below.

faq_section.heading: Bus ticket FAQs: Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau
faq_section.intro: Still need help? Call 1900 6763 or chat Zalo.

faq.q: How much is a Hai Van bus ticket from Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau?
faq.a: Choose your date and a departure from District 1 to Vung Tau, then check fares by vehicle class and seat. Prices can differ between departures; review the fare for the seat you want to book.

faq.q: How long does the bus from Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau take?
faq.a: Allow roughly three hours, depending on traffic, pickup location and transfers. Compare the estimated arrival with your hotel check-in plans; a nearby hotel drop-off must be confirmed for your address.

faq.q: Where does the District 1 to Vung Tau bus pick up passengers?
faq.a: A central Ho Chi Minh City service location is at 34 Nguyen Thai Binh, Ben Thanh. Check the pickup address and time confirmed for your departure before travelling there.

faq.q: Can I be dropped off near my Vung Tau hotel or resort?
faq.a: Drop-off support is available near hotels or resorts within the Vung Tau service area. Provide your accommodation address so Hai Van can confirm the drop-off point and transfer conditions for your arrival.

faq.q: What should I check when choosing a Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau limousine bus?
faq.a: Check the Royal, Luxury or Economy class, vehicle photos, seat layout and amenities for the departure you select. Then compare suitable times and seat fares; general promotional photos do not replace trip-specific details.

faq.q: Can I choose several seats for a group travelling to Vung Tau?
faq.a: You can select one or more available seats on the trip’s layout. Check their positions if you want to sit together; adjacent seats are not guaranteed for the whole group. Selecting seats does not confirm a booking.

faq.q: How do I book a one-way bus from Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau?
faq.a: Choose your travel date, departure and available seats for this direction; no return date is required. Review the pickup point, destination and fare before following the booking instructions. Selecting seats does not mean your ticket is confirmed.

faq.q: How can international visitors book and pay?
faq.a: Choose your departure and seats, enter your contact details and verify your phone number when requested. Hai Van’s guide includes international cards; use a payment option available during your booking. Contact support if the verification code does not arrive.

faq.q: Where does the Tan Son Nhat airport bus to Vung Tau pick up?
faq.a: Hai Van has a desk at the airport pickup column inside Tan Son Nhat. Go straight there after landing for luggage help, ticketing and waiting; the vehicle collects you at the desk instead of sending you to an outdoor car park. Departures from Ho Chi Minh City run 5am to midnight, every 15–30 minutes.

faq.q: What are the first and last departures from Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau?
faq.a: The first departure leaves at 5am and the last at midnight, with a bus every 15–30 minutes.

faq.q: Is there a shuttle from other districts?
faq.a: Yes. Hai Van runs shuttles across most districts, bringing passengers to the main pickup points on the route. Coverage varies by departure and does not apply to discounted fares, so call 1900 6763 to confirm your area before booking.

faq.q: Is there a bus from Ho Chi Minh City to Ba Ria?
faq.a: Yes. The Vung Tau route stops in Ba Ria at 54 Le Thanh Duy, Phuoc Trung Ward. Choose that drop-off point when booking.

faq.q: What should I check about the date and direction before choosing a trip?
faq.a: Check the route Ho Chi Minh City → Vung Tau, travel date and passenger count before choosing a trip. This page sells one-way tickets; the opposite direction and round trips have their own pages.

faq.q: How do I confirm my pickup and drop-off points?
faq.a: Check the pickup address and meeting time on your ticket. Confirm the hotel meeting point if you need a transfer in Vung Tau.

faq.q: Why can the vehicle and fare differ between trips?
faq.a: Product name, seat count, amenities and fare can differ by trip; confirm them before paying.

faq.q: Who can help with travelling with a child or changing my trip?
faq.a: Contact Hai Van on 1900 6763 to confirm seating for your child and the change conditions for your ticket. Provide your travel date, route and booking reference if you already have one.
